title: gtm-cs-1on1-prep-samira-patel-aaron-li-2026-03-26
body:
Meeting: 1:1 with Aaron Li (AE) - prep notes
Date: 2026-03-26
Length: 30m
Goals for this 1:1:
- Align on priority customers for next 2 weeks (risk + expansion)
- Quick sync on EBRs + slide asks from Aaron
- Confirm owner + timing for ProServe intro to Alpine Health
- Decide follow-ups and assign actions before Friday

Quick context (notes to self):
- Aaron has been pushing to close three expansion opportunities in Q2; two are mid-stage (Alpine Health, NovaRetail), one is proof-of-concept (LexiTech) that needs pricing clarified.
- Alpine Health: security questions still outstanding; they asked for on-prem deployment docs and KMS/HSM integration checklist. Aaron asked for a short handoff to ProServe last week - need to confirm cadence.
- NovaRetail: good CSAT, but usage plateauing - potential churn risk if we don't propose optimization (batching + quantization) to reduce cost per inference.
- LexiTech: POC using hosted API; finance flagged outstanding invoice that could block expansion.

Agenda (30m):
1) 3-4 min quick personal check-in
2) 8-10 min account review (Alpine Health, NovaRetail, LexiTech) - red/yellow/green + ask from AE
3) 8 min EBR/slide request + metrics we can provide (cost savings, latency, error rates)
4) 6-8 min action items + owners + deadlines

Talking points / prompts I want to cover:
- Alpine Health: what specifically are they asking from ProServe? (technical deep-dive vs kickoff call) Do they have completed security questionnaire?
- Offer to provide an on-prem quickstart doc + checklist by EOD Wed (I can draft, need Aaron to confirm scope)
- NovaRetail: propose a short pilot of Redwood Optimize recommendations - we can show expected $/1k tokens improvement. Ask Aaron for a 1 pager - we produce technical steps + projected savings.
- LexiTech: confirm invoice status and whether AE can unblock with finance; ask for go/no-go date for POC to be considered on-track.

Notes to record during meeting:
- Alpine Health: Aaron will intro ProServe on Mon 30th; needs our KMS/HSM checklist and SOC2 excerpts. Follow-up: Samira to send checklist + sample SOC2 redacted by 2026-03-29 (owner: Samira).
- NovaRetail: Aaron to approve pilot scope by 2026-03-28; if approved, SRE + Applied ML to join kickoff week of 2026-04-06. Owner: Aaron (commit), Samira to draft pilot outline by 2026-03-27.
- LexiTech: invoice cleared by Aaron with Finance by 2026-03-26 (today). If not cleared, escalate to AE manager.

Action items (explicit):
- Samira: Draft Alpine Health on-prem quickstart + KMS/HSM checklist + redacted SOC2 excerpts - due 2026-03-29 (format: 1-pager + appendix).
- Aaron: Confirm ProServe intro timing & scope for Alpine Health - due 2026-03-26 (today).
- Samira + Applied ML: Prepare NovaRetail pilot draft (goals, technical changes, estimated cost delta) - Samira to draft baseline by 2026-03-27; schedule deep-dive with Applied ML if Aaron approves.
- Aaron: Resolve LexiTech invoice with Finance or confirm next steps - due 2026-03-26.
- Samira: Prep EBR metrics slice for Alpine + Nova (last 90 days): avg latency, 95p latency, token spend, error rate - due 2026-03-28.

Risks / blockers to bring up:
- ProServe bandwidth: check availability for Alpine in early April - if not available, propose alternative (solutions consultant or SRE lead).
- Security docs: Legal may need extra time to redact SOC2; flag that to Aaron so expectations managed.
- NovaRetail technical owner buy-in - if AE can't get their technical lead engaged, pilot may stall.

Open questions / follow-ups for Aaron to answer in meeting:
- Does Alpine require on-prem proof-of-concept or is a hosted-dedicated demo acceptable?
- Who on the Alpine side is the technical PM? Need contact + timezone.
- For NovaRetail, what metric will they consider success for the cost-optimization pilot? (target $/token or latency delta)

Possible resolution language to use in notes (for cadence + record):
- Action: Samira to deliver on-prem quickstart + KMS checklist by 2026-03-29; Aaron to introduce ProServe on Mon 2026-03-30.
- Action: Pilot scope for NovaRetail to be approved by 2026-03-28; if not approved, escalate to AE manager for re-prioritization.

Follow-up templates (quick copy for Slack / email):
- To Aaron after call (Slack): 'Thanks Aaron - capturing next steps: 1) I'll send Alpine quickstart + KMS checklist by 3/29. 2) Draft NovaRetail pilot by 3/27 pending your approval. 3) Let me know on LexiTech invoice. Assigning owners in the doc; will follow up Fri if no update.'
- To Alpine (post-intro) (email): 'Thanks for the time today - attaching the on-prem quickstart and KMS/HSM checklist. Happy to set a 30m follow-up with ProServe and our SRE lead next week to review integration plan.'

Extras / scratchpad (things to possibly attach):
- Link to on-prem quickstart template (internal): CONFLUENCE-ONPREM-QUICKSTART
- KMS integration notes (short): internal link to security repo
- Short list of ProServe engineers and availability (ask PS manager)

Personal notes (for coaching):
- Keep the convo solutions-focused - don't get pulled into pricing debate until we align on technical scope.
- Use slightly higher assertiveness on deadlines (we need owners) - Aaron is good at follow-through when dates are explicit.
- Check his bandwidth this week; if overloaded, suggest deferring non-critical asks to next week.

End of doc.

(Internal history: created as prep for weekly 1:1 rhythm with AEs. Many of these items will repeat across accounts; reuse templates after this run.)
